system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

You can disappear in shadow or moonlight.

When you use this ability, choose Astral or Umbral Cloak.

  • Astral Cloak

    • You become invisible as long as you remain in moonlight.

    • If you leave the moonlight, this effect immediately ends.

  • Umbral Cloak

    • You become invisible as long as you remain in shadow.

    • If you leave the shadow, this effect immediately ends.

This effect ends also immediately if you attack a creature, cast a spell, or use a hostile ability.

This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect. If you do so, you may change between the Astral or Umbral effects.

Effects: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.f91aaqL6IrBFVNur]{Astral Cloak}, @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.xFQfvarl7Kcc9BGS]{Umbral Cloak}
